title: Failure of the Weak Sard property without Anomalous Dissipation
summary: For every $α\in(0,1)$ we construct an autonomous, divergence-free vector field $u \in C^α_c(\mathbb{R}^2,\mathbb{R}^2)$ that does not have the weak Sard property and, nonetheless, does not induce anomalous dissipation of $L^2(\mathbb{R}^2)$ norm for solutions to the associated advection-diffusion equation. This disproves a conjecture proposed by Bagnara, Boutros, De Lellis and Mayboroda in \cite{BaBoDeMa26}.
